Class PeriodicSubsystem

java.lang.Object
com.stuypulse.robot.util.PeriodicSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.wpilib.command3.Mechanism
Direct Known Subclasses:
Swerve, Vision
public abstract class PeriodicSubsystem extends Object implements org.wpilib.command3.Mechanism
A standard subsystem that includes an extra periodic callback which runs after the command scheduler. Allows outputs to be published after all other periodic code has finished.
